item.title: Bambu Bar 2.1.1
item.description:
Bambu Bar 2.1.1 speaks your language everywhere.

Translations

  • Text added since 1.5.0 now shows in your language instead of English: the camera settings and messages, the supporter license screen, update messages, and the setup and privacy texts.
  • Every translation in all 17 languages was reviewed, so wording is clearer and more consistent: printer stages, fan names, chamber and bed terms, and macOS's own names for Settings, Keychain and widgets.
  • In German, Swedish, Japanese, Korean and Chinese, the Printers page has its own name in the sidebar, so it no longer reads the same as the Printer page.

Other changes

  • The license screen's link to your purchase account is now called Manage Purchase: the supporter license is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs, Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 26 or later.
